notablePrerequisites:
Blazing Sunsteel attached to Zalto.
You have a way to give Zalto indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Zalto.
description:
Give Zalto indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Zalto.
Blazing Sunsteel and Zalto trigger.
Resolve the Zalto trigger, causing you to venture into the dungeon.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing that much damage to Zalto.
Repeat from step 3.
